info.description: Strict executable contract for the loopback Burp REST extension. JSON API responses use ApiResponse envelopes; GET /docs returns this raw OpenAPI document. x-burpctl-support marks discoverable operations unavailable in pinned Montoya.

put.description: If the import completes but the post-import export fails, the success response reports applied=true, config=null, and a do-not-retry warning.

Imports user options after excluding user_options.extender.extensions, because re-importing Burp extension inventory reloads the serving extension. The response lists this omission in excludedPaths. If the import completes but the post-import export fails, the success response reports applied=true, config=null, and a do-not-retry warning.

post.description: A vulnerable result requires the unauthenticated response to contain protectedContentMarker, a server-held value the probe never sends. Without that marker, equal successful responses are inconclusive rather than proof; COOKIE_ONLY is descriptive context, not authority.
Auth-bypass findings require protectedContentMarker in the unauthenticated response; equal responses without it are reported inconclusive.

ApiResponse.description: Typed error envelope used by non-success responses.

bodyBase64.description: Exact raw request bytes encoded as Base64. When present, takes precedence over body; otherwise body is encoded as UTF-8.

CreateTabRequest.description: Exactly one of request or requestId is required; an explicitly blank name is invalid.

protectedContentMarker.description: Server-held content that the unauthenticated probe never supplies; required before a protected read can be reported vulnerable.
